note: apex311-rc1111d-1112 (2026-11-12, docs/259 §8, Rodney option 1): Apex 3.1.1 live check on the release pair rc1111d asi (0.36.240 f05a9fd6) + rc1111d ini (9b5222c0) + ts3fixes rc1111e (a563cf8f). Four jobs, two installs done by hand between runs: --only the two -dxvk jobs with ApexRadiance.asi next to DXVK d3d9.dll, then --only the two -bridge jobs with the full RTX Remix bridge install (zip unzipped into Bin, DXVK moved out, verified). Bin backed up whole and hash-checked after. node tools/harness/queue.ts tools/harness/queues/apex311-rc1111d-1112.json --only <ids> --no-smoke
